items.concept: Initial recognition JEs for common, convertible preferred, and two series of convertible bonds; period-end adjusting JEs that finalize interest, tax, and preferred claim (emphasis); ranking by earnings per incremental share; sequential diluted EPS schedule with one antidilutive exclusion; period-end closing; dual EPS presentation; post-period conversion settlement JE

Number-variant twin of multi-security ranking and sequential diluted EPS; initial recognition JEs; period-end interest/tax/preferred AJs (emphasis); subsequent measurement ranking schedule; dual presentation; option-exercise settlement JE

Period-end ranking and sequential dilution using income from continuing operations as the control number; dual basic/diluted presentation for continuing operations, discontinued operations, and net income; period-end preferred dividend AJ and closing JE; warrant settlement JE
Classification of the correct inclusion order for multiple potentially dilutive securities
Classification of when a convertible is excluded from diluted EPS even if it appears dilutive versus basic EPS alone
